role: independent read-only artifact audit; only AUDIT_FINDINGS files added
aggregation: Equal recording/window means; 4 recordings per dataset; equal dataset macro. Dev/confirmation are disjoint VAL recordings, 2 per dataset; neither is TEST. All metrics listed are lower-is-better.

interpretation.scene_gain: Compare learned_only-minus-none: learned conditioning and learned geometry feedback both change; this does not isolate individual scene branches. Root-relative and PA gains support improvements beyond global translation, while root/height also contribute.
interpretation.physical_gain: Compare full-minus-learned_only: analytical guidance adds little World/PA improvement in this cohort and often worsens GT-low-speed foot velocity and acceleration; per-step energy descent is not proof of final motion improvement.
interpretation.energy_units: Dimensionless fixed-evidence weighted local objective: contact/0.05m, shallow plane/0.03m, slip/0.2m/s, head observation/0.05m, prior/0.03m, correction smoothness/0.01m, squared then weighted. Energy is conditional on active contact and alpha; skipped calls record zero, not achieved perfect physics. It is not training loss, mechanical energy or comparable across arms/windows.
interpretation.coverage: Near coverage uses valid anchors across query scales aggregated to 22 regions. Relation coverage uses broad relation valid; far_only is relation-valid and near-invalid. Large relation coverage suggests a high-value permission-gate diagnostic, not a proven bug.
interpretation.foot_metrics: Foot height is absolute error against GT foot joints, not signed scene collision or ground distance. GT-low-speed mask is GT 3D joint speed <0.2m/s, not contact ground truth.
interpretation.scope: 12 recording-fixed validation windows, not full validation/test. Strong cohort evidence cannot establish dataset-wide significance or replace a confirmation test.
